prologue.setting: You wake in a rented room above a fish market. On the table is a stranger's phone with one voice note.
prologue.voiceNoteTranscript: I'm sorry for what I left you. Don't trust the Notaries. Find the Ledger.

acts.name: The Will
acts.summary: Hollow Bay is run by the Notary Houses, who record every death and tax every inheritance. Learn the city's rules by living them.

acts.name: The Debt
acts.summary: Elias Vane founded Hollow Bay 200 years ago and bargained with the sea. Every lost day feeds him. Choose: Keepers or Breakers.

acts.name: The Last Will
acts.summary: The Ledger is scattered across thousands of inheritances. Pages must be handed down life to life. One careless voice note can lose a page forever.

factions.name: The Keepers
factions.creed: One-day lives mean no one is trapped by the past. Every heir gets a fresh start.

factions.name: The Breakers
factions.creed: People deserve to grow old and build lives that last.

characters.name: Elias Vane
characters.title: The Founder
characters.bio: A grieving father who lost his daughter Mara at sea. He made the bargain to bring her back, and has tried to undo it for 200 years.

characters.name: Mara Vane
characters.title: The Drowned Girl
characters.bio: Seen only at the waterline at dawn. She is the real reason the curse exists, and she does not want to be saved.

characters.name: Judge Orla Thrane
characters.title: Head of House Thrane
characters.bio: The most powerful Notary. Charming and patient, she has kept one family line alive for 80 years by cheating the inheritance rules.

characters.name: Kit Morrow
characters.title: Breaker Leader
characters.bio: A young dockworker who inherited the first Ledger page. Brave, reckless, and hiding that the page came from someone she betrayed.

characters.name: The Ferryman
characters.title: Rower of the Dead
characters.bio: A silent figure who rows each dead citizen out at sunrise. The only one who has seen every life. He speaks once per season.

twists.title: The bargain was for Mara
twists.text: Vane didn't trade the city's tomorrows for his own life. He traded them to bring his drowned daughter back for one day, every day, forever.

twists.title: Thrane has been cheating death
twists.text: Judge Thrane forges wills so her family's wealth stays inside one bloodline. Some of you have been her family's heirs without knowing it.

twists.title: Kit stole the first page
twists.text: Kit Morrow got the first Ledger page by letting another citizen drown. That citizen's heir wants revenge.

twists.title: Mara wants the curse to stay
twists.text: Breaking the curse means Mara dies for good. At the waterline she begs you to keep it.

twists.title: You are the Ledger
twists.text: There is no single hidden book. The Ledger is every voice note ever recorded. The Will is read aloud from your own messages.

endings.breakers: The curse breaks. Next season's lives last a full week.
endings.keepers: The curse holds. Vane's spirit passes to the faction leader, and a new player becomes the hidden Founder.
endings.ferryman: The Ferryman takes Vane's place. Mara and Vane share one last sunrise at the waterline, and the Ferryman rows away.
endings.finalLine: Everything I had, I leave to whoever comes next.

houses.name: Room above the fish market
houses.description: Salt-stained floorboards, one window, gulls on the sill.

houses.name: Lighthouse keeper's cottage
houses.description: A spiral stair and a lamp that hasn't been lit in years.

houses.name: Narrow house on Tallow Lane
houses.description: Three floors, every one of them leaning toward the harbour.

houses.name: Notary clerk's flat
houses.description: Ledgers stacked to the ceiling. None of them the one you want.

houses.name: Boathouse on the north quay
houses.description: It smells of tar and something older.

houses.name: Faded mansion on Vane Hill
houses.description: Too many rooms, most of them locked from the inside.

feudReasons: an insult at the Reading of a Will

items.name: Brass pocket watch
items.description: Stopped at 5:12, the minute of last sunrise.

items.name: Jar of sea glass
items.description: Every piece is green except one red shard.

items.name: Silver christening spoon
items.description: Engraved with initials that aren't yours.

items.name: Share in a fishing boat
items.description: The Gull's Mercy. One quarter of her is yours.

items.name: Market stall licence
items.description: Stamped by House Merrow. Expires at sunrise, like everything.

items.name: Oilskin coat
items.description: The pockets are full of someone else's receipts.

items.name: Notary's wax seal
items.description: House Thrane. You should not have this.

items.name: Key to a harbour locker
items.description: Locker 41. Nobody remembers what's in it.

clues.title: A torn receipt
clues.text: Paid to the Ferryman: 'one crossing, return.' There are no return crossings.

clues.title: Chalk marks on the door
clues.text: Three tallies, then a fourth crossed out. Someone was counting heirs.

clues.title: A name in the margin
clues.text: Elias Vane, written in a hand that isn't the owner's, in every book on the shelf.

clues.title: The lighthouse logbook
clues.text: The lamp was last lit the night a girl drowned, two hundred years ago.

clues.title: A Notary's letter
clues.text: 'The bloodline must hold. Forge the next one as before.' Signed with an O.

clues.title: Wet footprints
clues.text: Small, bare footprints leading from the waterline to your door. They stop at the threshold.

clues.title: A dockworker's IOU
clues.text: 'Kit, I'll pay you back when the tide turns.' The tide never turned for him.

clues.title: A map of the old harbour
clues.text: One pier is drawn that was never built. It ends at a door in the sea.

ledgerPageTexts: To the sea I give the city's tomorrows. To my daughter, one more dawn.
Let every citizen keep a single day, and let that day be enough.
The Notaries will record what passes. They must never record what is lost.
Should the Will be read entire, my debt is paid, and I may sleep.
Whoever holds these pages holds my memory. Do not hold it long.
Mara, if they read this, I am sorry. I could not let you stay.
The Ferryman alone may take my place, and only if he is asked kindly.

personalStories.title: The unfinished letter
personalStories.text: A love letter, never finished. Deliver it, or burn it.

item.name: Unfinished love letter
item.description: 'My dearest — I should have told you before the' ... it stops there.

personalStories.title: The missing child
personalStories.text: A note on the pillow: 'Find my son before sunrise.'

clue.title: Find my son before sunrise
clue.text: He was last seen near the north quay, asking about the Ferryman.

personalStories.title: The family secret
personalStories.text: A locked box that only opens after five heirs in a row choose to keep it.

item.name: Locked iron box
item.description: Five keyholes. Some of them are already turned.

personalStories.title: The revenge chain
personalStories.text: A murder in one life makes a hunter in the next, until someone forgives.

feud.rival: the heir of a drowned man
